The current progress on AI makes me want to have kids.

I never thought I'd have the time. I thought I'd have to work my whole life to make the world what I wanted to.

But now I set up my agents, they run, and I go about my life.

25x more Github commits than I made 4 years ago killing myself 14 hours a day.

I remember being young and having questions about the world, and nobody who knew the answers.

Now, every time I have a question, no matter how small, I ask. I run research. I read and I learn.

And I am so much smarter and more knowledgeable about the world than I was.

I would have killed to have that when I was a kid.

It would be so awesome to be a kid now. To have an idea for a video game and to just create it and play it and share it. To have a question about life that I was afraid of asking any adult, and to know the answer. To truly know what's going on, with no sugar coating, without the biases of the adults I happen to be around.

If you're clicking through GUIs, if you're writing reports– just let the AI do it. Set it up, go outside, spend time with your family, come back when it's cooked.

This isn't the end of anything except a way of living that was never ideal.

It's the beginning of something absolutely incredible.

Get more work done than you ever did before. Spend that time raising a family, knowing God, helping other people, asking the questions and knowing the answers.

There's so much more to life that most of us have never had the time for.

And now we do.

And the sooner we get there, the less people die, the more diseases are cured, the better the world will be for those who come next.

It's almost time for this chapter to end, and a new chapter of humanity to begin. The 14 hour workday, the startup grind, all of this will go away, and we'll be left with our families and our loved ones and our understanding of God and the nature of reality.

And it will be glorious.

tweets.text: 欢迎大家提出宝贵意见，产品改进建议。

律动 BlockBeats 关于 fomo App 错误报道的情况说明

2026 年 9 月 23 日 19 点 38 分，律动 BlockBeats 发布并推送了《fomo 官方 iOS 应用包含加密窃取恶意软件》的新闻。

事实上，该应用全名为「FomoPeek」，而我们的推送方式让非常多的用户误解为现在非常热门的交易应用 @fomo  App 使用者有资产被盗风险。

很快，我们的内容错误就在社交媒体上引起了广泛讨论，许多人质疑该条消息是收到了竞品的「付费投放（黑稿）」。（图 1）

因为就在同一时期，海外 KOL 开始集中声讨在 fomo 上交易的亏损情况，说 fomo 的车头集体喊单骗散户。（图 2）

了解到这一情况后，我们团队随即开展自查，首先确定的是，律动 BlockBeats 的所有商务合作行为里，从来不包含所谓竞争对手间的付费抹黑行为，即便在以前曾经收到过类似的需求，我们也是会直接拒绝的，所以我们把重点放在了是否有内容同事私下接受了「付费黑稿」

我们复盘了该内容的全部发布流程，其实早在 9 月 19 日，我们就第一时间发布过「FomoPeek」存在安全风险的消息。但是该产品知名度并不高，所以没有引起任何行业讨论。（图 3）

对于安全类新闻，涉及用户资产，我们一贯的要求是越早让大家知道越好，一方面是这是用户真正需要知道的，另一方面是该类消息确实关注度比较高，所以对于我们来说流量也比较好，所以无论这个安全事件或大或小，我们都会第一时间报道。

所以在 23 日，又有其他信源发布了这条安全消息的时候，我们的值班编辑又是选择第一时间发布，可没想到该信源报道的就是在一周前我们已经发布过的「FomoPeek」的安全风险提示。

我们的值班编辑却没有再确认核对名字，直接写作「fomo」进行了发布，最低级的错误造成的是最严重的后果。

fomo App 已经是行业里几乎所有人都知道的名字，我们却把它和一个恶意软件写在了一起。在这里我代表律动 BlockBeats 全体同事，向 fomo 团队，向所有被这条错误信息影响到的人真诚道歉。

同时，我们可以确定的是，整个过程中不存在任何「付费黑稿」行为。

关于这位新闻编辑，我们已经做了处理。迅速核实了整个经过，也确认了责任所在。我们也会在内部把这条新闻当成一个案例，重新强调一遍审核流程。

发现问题后，我们立即下架了那条新闻，我们在第一时间开始做补救措施，用户无法在首页、搜索以及我们的各个分发渠道再看到这条新闻，随后我们更新了最新、正确的版本，把这个恶意软件的名字改正为 FomoPeek，后面的所有分发也都以更正后的版本为准。对已经看到过错版本的用户，在这里再说一声抱歉，这个影响我们无法完全抹掉，但后面每一条内容，我们会用更严的标准来弥补。

律动 BlockBeats 进入行业这些年，一直在专注做内容这一件事，尤其在这两年这样的市场环境下，行业里少有创新，亮点、我们更应该爱护。这是我们做媒体的初衷，也是我们愿意一直做这件事的原因。

事情发生后看到很多用户通过各种渠道和平台找到或者@我们，告诉我们新闻有误，真的很感动也很愧疚，辜负了大家的信任。

今后任何涉及安全、涉及具体主体和产品名字的内容，我们都要求二次核对后再发。今后如果大家发现我们有内容错误，也请像这次一样直接来告诉我们，这对我们是极大的帮助。

这封道歉信，希望能够取得读者用户、 fomo 用户、各位社区用户的谅解。

再次诚挚道歉。

kalshi, a u.s. exchange for trading contracts on event outcomes, lost an appeal on september 25. the sixth circuit let ohio and tennessee enforce gambling rules against its sports contracts, holding that federal commodities law wouldn't override them even if the contracts count as swaps. kalshi earns fees on trades, and sports were 78.3% of its july volume. courts are now split, since new jersey lost to kalshi in the third circuit.

tweets.text:
i’m looking at SOL through a much longer time horizon than current revenue

if crypto keeps moving capital and assets onchain, the L1s that become core infrastructure should be valued around the activity they could support over decades

Solana today only has a small number of applications generating serious revenue

the upside case comes from what happens if that becomes hundreds or thousands of successful businesses built onchain

for me, that future activity matters more than a snapshot of L1 economics today

i’m treating this cycle on its own terms

previous major BTC bear markets took roughly a year to find their lows and drew down 75%+ from the top

this time, the deepest drawdown so far has been closer to 53%, followed by a much earlier recovery in price

the market structure has changed too, with new ways for institutions and retail to enter crypto and move onchain

memory mapping every move to 2018 or 2022 feels less useful when the setup itself has changed

i view dedicated social trading apps keeping their edge even if X eventually brings trading directly into the timeline

X serves too many different use cases, while these apps are designed around discovering trades and acting on them quickly

the callout model takes that a step further by connecting attention directly to trading volume

if creators can earn from the volume their posts generate, that creates a pretty powerful loop between content, distribution and trading

It's an underappreciated triumph of Ethereum client developers that PeerDAS has now been running for nearly a year with basically no problems.

PeerDAS was a complex task: it's the first large-scale instance of a blockchain that achieves consensus on the availability of data without needing any single node to download the entire block. Decentralized consensus without replication.

And yet, it worked.
HT @sriramkiron @arferrari @0x94t3z for making the above three

Testing out some of the mobile offline local knowledge apps that people have been trying to build

(see here https://t.co/cjtSqLgbc6 )

Definitely getting much better than the one I tried to build myself 2 months ago. But also still much slower and less effective at difficult questions than the models that can run on a laptop.

It's weakest at specialized travel-related queries (eg. my eval is "Tell me the best vegan restaurants in [city I am currently in]", unfortunately none of these performed well on that)

Looking forward to seeing these continue to improve! I hope we can soon get to the point where you can comfortably look up any facts about the world that you care about without needing to access the internet at all.
